Fitting-free groups). When our groups are given as quotients of permutation groups, we exhibit a polynomial-time algorithm for constructing such representations. verdicts.title: Representation Theory of Finite Groups
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The point of view of these notes on the topic is to bring out the flavour that Representation Theory is an extension of the first course on Group Theory. We also emphasize the importance of the base field. These notes cover completely the theory over complex numbers which is Character Theory. A large number of worked-out examples are the main feature of these notes. The prerequisite for this note is basic group theory and linear algebra.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract describes introductory notes on representation theory of finite groups over complex numbers (character theory), which shares no specific interaction with Grothendieck groups of matroids, boolean formulas, or Frege proof depth.
